## Summary

Describe the purpose and main code/configuration changes.

## Validation

- [ ] `make verify` or equivalent unit tests
- [ ] Shell scripts pass `shellcheck` / `bash -n`
- [ ] `docker compose config --quiet` succeeds
- [ ] Image builds for relevant profile and platform
- [ ] `make smoke` and `make test-persistence` (if runtime changed)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private keys, or workspace data committed
- [ ] Security implications and documentation reviewed

## Compatibility notes

State OpenCode version, Alpine/CPU assumptions, and any known limitations.
